title: Crown and Wolf
author: Ivo Fairweather
blurb: Sable Kavanagh, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
